title: Motion terms reduce fitted image moment responses at two known weak signals of KIC 5520878 in Kepler Q2 to Q16
abstract: We test image moment responses at the two known weak signals near 1.13 cycles per day in KIC 5520878. In Kepler release 25 quarters 2 to 16, adding image motion terms reduces the median fitted moment amplitude from 0.0314 to 0.00883 millipixel with 20-day local fits. The reduction also occurs with 10-day and 40-day fits. A design check gives at most 2.04 percent loss of target information in the main fit. Six of 60 conditional intervals still exclude zero. A selected quarter-7 response does not repeat in three quarters of the same detector season. These tests show strong model dependence. They do not locate the variable source, exclude all blends, or establish a new mode or planet. Errors are conditional, and independent telescope confirmation is absent. The package includes source hashes, code, projected fit matrices, selected data, results and offline checks.

display.caption: In-phase moment-to-flux ratios with and without local image motion terms. Error bars are conditional 95 percent intervals.
